channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: After 7 years at McKinsey, I left to build an AI healthtech startup. I had to unlearn the pursuit of perfection.
item.description: Julius Bruch spent seven years at McKinsey before founding an AI dementia startup. He shares what made the leap hard — and why consulting helped.

item.title: I flew drones on Ukraine's fiercest battlefield. The last few months laid bare the limits of today's drone warfare.
item.description: Sgt. Dimko Zhluktenko, a commander of a drone team, told Business Insider what it was like flying in the heavy fog that Russia used to its advantage.

item.title: Powell says the Fed received DOJ subpoenas
item.description: "This is about whether the Fed will be able to continue to set interest rates based on evidence and economic conditions," Powell said on Sunday.

item.title: The best-dressed celebrities at the 2026 Golden Globes
item.description: Celebrities attended the 2026 Golden Globes on Sunday. Selena Gomez and Colman Domingo were among the best-dressed stars of the night.

item.title: 10 celebrity looks that missed the mark at the 2026 Golden Globes
item.description: There was no shortage of high-fashion looks at the 2026 Golden Globes, but some stars, such as Jennifer Lopez, missed the mark with their outfits.

item.title: Russia's next-gen 'Geran-5' drone has a powerful new Chinese jet engine and might soon fire missiles, Ukraine says
item.description: Ukraine said the "Geran-5" bears similarities to Iran's Karrar attack drone, and uses a more powerful engine than Russia's current turbojet Shaheds.

item.title: A Google AI product manager has a career advice: 'Be a crab'
item.description: A Google AI product manager says moving sideways and using what you already know is the best way to break into product roles.

item.title: Trump said he's 'inclined' to keep ExxonMobil out of Venezuela
item.description: Trump said he didn't like Exxon's response to his $100 billion plan for Venezuela. Exxon CEO Darren Woods said Venezuela is "uninvestable."

item.title: Helen Mirren, 80, has a blunt message for tech bros chasing eternal youth
item.description: "Life is finite. There is no fighting that — as much as people like to put themselves into ice, hoping that they might wake up in 50 years," Helen Mirren said.

item.title: The most viral Gen Z names in K-pop and Hollywood met backstage at the Golden Globes
item.description: The breakout stars of the steamy hockey romance, "Heated Rivalry," met Seventeen vocalist Joshua Hong at the Golden Globes, and fans ate it up.
